columns.name: display_name
columns.check: display_name IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(display_name)) >= 1 AND char_length(btrim(display_name)) <= 120

columns.name: avatar_url
columns.check: avatar_url IS NULL OR char_length(avatar_url) <= 2048 AND avatar_url ~ '^https://'::text

tables.name: public.user_modules
tables.comment: Preferencia; ausencia significa visivel e ordem do catalogo em codigo. Nunca autoriza acesso.

tables.name: public.user_moderation
tables.comment: Estado atual privado de moderacao. Sem policy/grant de authenticated. Motivo nunca entra em domain_events.

columns.name: reason
columns.check: reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) >= 1 AND char_length(reason) <= 500

tables.name: public.user_entitlements
tables.comment: Plano Pessoal implicito: ausencia permite; false veta. Atualizavel somente por canal administrativo.

tables.name: public.domain_events
tables.comment: Append-only para aplicacao; limpeza privilegiada de 90 dias. Admin nao recebe conteudo de outros usuarios.

columns.name: entity_type
columns.check: (entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['profile'::text, 'preference'::text, 'module_preference'::text, 'role'::text, 'moderation'::text, 'entitlement'::text, 'authentication'::text, 'capture'::text, 'task'::text, 'finance_account'::text, 'finance_category'::text, 'finance_tag'::text, 'finance_transaction'::text, 'finance_budget'::text])) OR (entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['knowledge_notebook'::text, 'knowledge_page'::text, 'knowledge_link'::text])) OR (entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['project'::text, 'habit'::text, 'habit_entry'::text, 'habit_pause'::text, 'project_container'::text])) OR (entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['drive_folder'::text, 'drive_file'::text])) OR entity_type = 'vault_metadata'::text OR (entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['calendar_account'::text, 'calendar_source'::text, 'calendar_event'::text, 'calendar_sync'::text])) OR (entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['onboarding_round'::text, 'onboarding_entry'::text, 'profile_focus'::text, 'project_context'::text])) OR (entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['finance_series'::text, 'finance_series_occurrence'::text])) OR (entity_type = ANY (ARRAY['finance_goal'::text, 'finance_goal_reservation'::text, 'finance_goal_release'::text, 'finance_goal_highlight'::text])) OR entity_type = 'finance_goal_disposition'::text

tables.name: app_private.command_receipts
tables.comment: Escopo usuario+comando+client_id; request estrutural e result gravados com dado+evento. Sem expiracao automatica.

tables.name: app_private.rate_limits
tables.comment: Estado operacional: login usa HMAC-SHA256 server-only; escrita usa SHA256 do UUID. Nunca email/IP/senha em claro. Login pre-auth nao possui user_id.

tables.name: public.categories
tables.comment: Organization reader only in T015. No seed or create/update RPC until its own domain commands exist.

tables.name: public.projects
tables.comment: Organization reader only; deleted_at preserves historical references. No seed or mutating API in T015.

tables.name: public.captures
tables.comment: T015 domain JSON preserved verbatim; relational columns are derived/validated by trigger. No direct application DML or uploads yet.

tables.name: public.tasks
tables.comment: T015 tasks; capture conversion and original timestamp strings are preserved. Physical removal only via privileged lifecycle.

tables.name: app_private.capture_task_revisions
tables.comment: Per-user CAS covers all capture/task/reference/event/receipt writes. Owner operations must use the same lock ordering.

columns.name: last_four
columns.comment: Optional four-digit card identifier, never PAN or CVV.

columns.name: default_payment_account_id
columns.comment: Editable payment suggestion only; never automatic payment.

columns.name: is_paid
columns.comment: Generated from paid_cents. Never accepted in domain DTOs or client writes.

columns.name: statement_month
columns.check: statement_month IS NULL OR EXTRACT(day FROM statement_month) = 1::numeric

columns.name: category_id
columns.comment: NULL is the owner total monthly plan; a UUID is an expense-category budget of the same owner.

tables.name: public.knowledge_pages
tables.comment: T021 canonical editable page. origin_capture_id is unique; capture remains frozen historical input.

tables.name: public.links
tables.comment: Closed polymorphic links with both directional indexes. Owner/existence verified by server-only commands.

tables.name: app_private.admin_operations
tables.comment: Fail-closed Auth saga reservations. Stores keyed commitment only; no password/e-mail/ciphertext. UUID and marker reconcile unknown creation.

tables.name: public.admin_audit_events
tables.comment: Metadata-only append-only administrative history. No e-mail, password, credential or personal module content.

columns.name: image_file_id
columns.comment: Private finalized habit_image owned by the same User; archives retain the live link.

tables.name: public.drive_files
tables.comment: Measured immutable final metadata. Trash keeps quota until orphan purge acknowledgment; no direct owner writes.

tables.name: app_private.upload_reservations
tables.comment: Server-only owner lease/quota accounting. Signed URLs/tokens never stored, emitted or journaled.

tables.name: public.vault_master_keys
tables.comment: Client-wrapped data key only; no JWT policies or direct grants. Password and recovery kit never reach the server.

tables.name: app_private.google_credentials
tables.comment: AES-256-GCM envelope bound by AAD to owner/account/credential-version/key-id; no direct reads/grants.

tables.name: app_private.google_oauth_flows
tables.comment: Ten-minute session-bound single-consume OAuth state digests; no code, verifier or tokens.

tables.name: public.calendar_sync_runs
tables.comment: Metadata only: ids, source channel, status, counts and timings; never event content, e-mail or tokens.

tables.name: app_private.onboarding_rounds
tables.comment: Draft schema1, optional explicit opt-in; no heuristic enrollment. Logical expiry is exactly720 hours after last confirmed content edit; physical removal requires active measured native retention sweep. No billing.

columns.name: draft
columns.check: draft IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(draft) = 'object'::text AND octet_length(draft::text) <= 98304

tables.name: app_private.onboarding_intents
tables.comment: Stable module receipt binding, one effect per advance. Confirmed content is scrubbed. A version is reconciled or transactionally revoked before explicit amendment admits a new version. Payload is scrubbed; minimal proof remains.

columns.name: image_file_id
columns.comment: Optional finalized private finance_goal_image; archived Goals retain the reference. Payload projection, never a separate binding command.

tables.name: app_private.finance_goal_dispositions
tables.comment: Permanent command fence until Auth identity cascade. No request/result, temporal pruning or browser grants. Restore must preserve fences or reject old generations before activation.
